step_description: Fix golangci-lint/gosec/govulncheck failures caused by hgm-infra/verifiers containing multiple Go 'main' programs in a single package; split verifier tools into separate cmd subdirectories and update the verifier entrypoint; rerun verifier and capture updated evidence.
prompt_text:
Objective
You are executing roadmap step M1-CON-2 (Consistency: Lint/static analysis green with pinned tooling). The current rubric report fails CON-2, SEC-1, and SEC-2 due to a *false failure* caused by Go typecheck errors in hgm-infra verifier code: the directory hgm-infra/verifiers contains multiple 'package main' files that both declare main() and collectGoFiles(), which breaks tools that analyze ./... (golangci-lint, gosec, govulncheck).

Your job in this step is strictly to make the verifier helper programs structurally valid Go packages so static analysis tools can load the repo. Do not attempt to remediate application behavior or rewrite logging across the codebase in this step.

Scope (allowed changes)
- You MAY modify files under:
  - hgm-infra/verifiers/**
  - hgm-infra/evidence/** (new evidence, progress notes)
  - hgm-infra/planning/** only if you need to note the baseline/result or add a TODO pointer
- You MUST NOT modify production/app code under pkg/**, cmd/**, internal/**, examples/** in this step.
- You MUST NOT weaken lint/security policy (no new blanket excludes, no disabling linters, no widening exclusions).

Why this step is next
- Current hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json shows overall FAIL with CON-2, SEC-1, SEC-2 failing.
- Evidence logs show the immediate cause is a Go compilation/typecheck error in hgm-infra/verifiers (duplicate main() / collectGoFiles()). Fixing this unblocks reliable verification and is the smallest, highest-leverage next step.

Inputs (read-only)
- hgm-infra/evidence/CON-2-output.log
- hgm-infra/evidence/SEC-1-output.log
- hgm-infra/evidence/SEC-2-output.log
- hgm-infra/verifiers/mai3-dupcheck.go
- hgm-infra/verifiers/com6-logging-standards-check.go
- hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh

Work to perform
1) Confirm the failure mode
   - Read CON-2/SEC-1/SEC-2 evidence logs and confirm they fail due to redeclared identifiers in hgm-infra/verifiers (multiple main packages in same directory).

2) Restructure verifier Go programs so they do not share a package
   - Create subdirectories so each verifier tool is its own package main, e.g.:
     - hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/mai3-dupcheck/main.go
     - hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check/main.go
   - Move the existing code from:
     - hgm-infra/verifiers/mai3-dupcheck.go -> .../cmd/mai3-dupcheck/main.go
     - hgm-infra/verifiers/com6-logging-standards-check.go -> .../cmd/com6-logging-standards-check/main.go
   - After moving, ensure there are no remaining .go files directly under hgm-infra/verifiers/ that define a Go package which will be included by golangci-lint as a single package with conflicting symbols.
   - Keep the program behavior identical; do not change COM-6 or MAI-3 policy logic in this step (only structural changes required for compilation).

3) Update the deterministic verifier entrypoint
   - In hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh, update the go run commands to point at the new directories (not the old single-file paths).
   - Example target shape (you can choose an equivalent that works):
     - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check
     - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/mai3-dupcheck
   - Do not change rubric IDs, thresholds, or command semantics beyond the minimal path changes.

4) Formatting & sanity
   - Ensure moved files are gofmt’d.
   - Sanity-check that each tool runs as before:
     - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/mai3-dupcheck
     - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check

5) Re-run the rubric verifier and capture updated evidence
   - Run:
     - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm that CON-2 / SEC-1 / SEC-2 no longer fail due to Go package load errors originating from hgm-infra/verifiers.
   - Note: these checks may still FAIL for real reasons (repo lint issues, real vulnerabilities, missing govulncheck tool). That is acceptable; the key requirement is: no more false failures due to verifier compilation conflicts.

6) Record progress (hgm-infra only)
   - Create a new progress note under hgm-infra/evidence/ named something like:
     - hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M1-CON-2-<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>.md
   - Include:
     - What was broken (duplicate main/collectGoFiles in one directory)
     - What you changed (moved to cmd/* packages; updated hgm-verify-rubric.sh)
     - Commands run
     - Pointers to evidence logs and updated hgm-rubric-report.json

Acceptance criteria
- golangci-lint / gosec / govulncheck no longer fail due to typecheck errors in hgm-infra/verifiers caused by duplicate mains in a single package.
- bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh runs to completion and produces a refreshed hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json.
- A progress note is recorded under hgm-infra/evidence/.

Guardrails (must-follow)
- Do not modify application code outside hgm-infra/.
- Do not change lint/security policy (no new excludes, no disabling linters, no threshold reductions).
- Do not write outside hgm-infra/.
guardrails: Only modify files under hgm-infra/ for this step

Do not weaken lint/security policy (no new blanket excludes, no disabling linters)
Write all evidence and notes under hgm-infra/evidence/
Ensure verifier behavior is unchanged aside from path/structure fixes
